Showcase.label: Airbnb version · example output
Showcase.text: Wake up to cobblestone streets and church bells: this sun-lit 2-bedroom apartment sits on a quiet courtyard just two minutes from Pilies Street, in the heart of Vilnius Old Town. High ceilings, a fully equipped kitchen, and a private balcony make it feel like home — whether you're here for a weekend or a month. Cafés, the Cathedral, and the river are all an easy walk away. Fast WiFi and a proper desk mean it works for remote workdays too. Perfect for couples, small families, or two friends who want to actually live in the Old Town, not just visit it.

Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.a1: Yes — you get {limit} free generations with no signup required. Pro unlocks unlimited use for €9/month.
Faq.q2: Why three different versions instead of one description?
Faq.a2: Airbnb guests read stories, Booking.com guests scan facts, and Instagram needs a short caption. HostCopy AI writes each one for how that platform's guests actually read.
Faq.q3: What does the Premium plan add?
Faq.a3: Premium adds an AI property walkthrough — upload photos or a link and it drafts a room-by-room tour — plus bulk generation for managing multiple listings at once.
Faq.q4: Do you store my listing information?
Faq.a4: No — your inputs are only used to generate the description and are not saved or shared.
Faq.q5: Why use HostCopy AI instead of ChatGPT or another AI tool?
Faq.a5: You technically could prompt ChatGPT yourself — the difference is HostCopy AI already has three separate, tuned prompts (Airbnb's warm/story tone, Booking.com's factual/scannable format, Instagram's short caption style) built in, so you get all three correctly formatted in one click instead of writing and adjusting three prompts yourself each time you list something.
